text:
A beam of particles moves through a magnetic field.
In which situation do the particles experience a magnetic force?
a beam of α-particles moving parallel to the magnetic field lines
A
B
a beam of electrons moving parallel to the magnetic field lines
a beam of β-particles moving perpendicularly across the magnetic field lines
C
D
a beam of neutrons moving perpendicularly across the magnetic field lines

options.label: A
options.text: a beam of α-particles moving parallel to the magnetic field lines

options.label: B
options.text: a beam of electrons moving parallel to the magnetic field lines

options.label: C
options.text: a beam of β-particles moving perpendicularly across the magnetic field lines

options.label: D
options.text: a beam of neutrons moving perpendicularly across the magnetic field lines
